model.title: A resolution expressing the sense of the Senate regarding the importance of religious freedom, authoritative texts, and transparency in artificial intelligence systems.

summary.text: The resolution expresses the Senate's view that artificial intelligence systems should respect religious freedom, rely on authoritative and trustworthy information sources, and operate with transparency so users understand how these systems work and make decisions.
